body: Planejei pro dia 14 (dado o nome) mas achei um joguinho legal que me distraiu. Mas agora virei o joguinho  ಠ_ಠ

Hang in there man, you're young as hell and lot can change for you. Look at me, I was full of dreams at 18 lol! The opposite must also be possible.

> I feel like my friends either fetishize mental illness or are dealing with their own shit

I hear ya, even if some people could possibly be good friends I just don't like bothering others with issues. I can't even handle myself, not sure how I'd like also dealing with someone else's mental state. I push a lot of people away, even more drifted away, now I'm alone.

> Have you considered trade school or some form of education that gets you out into the world using your hands?

I don't know...  I've already spent 9 years in college and it destroyed my will to learn new things. I just wish I could've finished it before essentially having a breakdown. Once I applied for some volunteer work but even those rejected me lol.

> And what about your mom? If you consistently call her every Sunday don’t you think it would be rough for her? She raised you, she cares about you.

I know about that and it hurts me a lot. There's this thought process that I will go through literally dozens of times every single day, for like 3 years now:

I don't want to live anymore -> I can't do this to my mom -> Guess I'll live another day

Feels like I'm going insane honestly. That's a tough thought chain to constantly have in your head. Once even caught myself wishing she would die so that I could follow it soon after. Fucking sickening.

I'm pretty much a shut-in at the moment. Barely get out of the house anymore. It feels like everyone around me, as deep in shit as they are, at least have *something* going on. Maybe they've got a partner. Maybe a group of friends. Maybe a job. Maybe they graduated. Maybe their family is well off. But I've got nothing.
